updated: October 1, 2026 — rerun with expanded ultra, avalanche, mountaineering and Oregon cycling sources
summary: A stacked weekend with three unusually strong local or near-local options: the full-grid 24 Hours of TCKC, Chinook Cycling's Columbia Park MTB race, and the temporary car-free Sunrise Road bicycle window at Mount Rainier. The expanded ultra-running search also surfaced Baker Lake 50K and Lastest Not Fastest as viable late-entry endurance options.

recommendations.title: 24 Hours of TCKC — NorthWest Mini Moto
recommendations.cost: Race/team fees vary; check organizer for spectator access
recommendations.description: NorthWest Mini Moto's Sept. 29 update confirms a full grid of 18 teams, its biggest ever. Friday practice is tentatively 5–9 PM with Cascadia SuperMoto, followed by the Oct. 3–4 endurance race using two track configurations.
recommendations.why: Rare, local, and directly aligned with your mini-moto/motorsports interests.

recommendations.title: Chinook Cycling Columbia Park MTB Race
recommendations.description: Chinook Cycling's newsletter confirms the next 2026 MTB series race is Oct. 3 at Columbia Park, with current trail prep and a race-day barbecue.
recommendations.why: Actual local MTB racing with almost no travel overhead; a strong inbox-only lead.

recommendations.title: Car-Free Sunrise Road
recommendations.weather: Sunny; summit-area forecast ~40–43°F and breezy, warmer lower on the road
recommendations.description: NPS still lists Sunrise Road closed to vehicles but open to bicycles and pedestrians. White River Road is open. No potable water is available at Sunrise, and administrative/fire traffic may still use the road.
recommendations.why: A temporary, high-value way to knock out your Mount Rainier road-bike wishlist objective with almost no normal tourist traffic.

recommendations.title: Baker Lake 50K
recommendations.weather: Cold mountain morning; nearby high-elevation forecast is sunny but near freezing overnight
recommendations.description: Northwest Endurance Events confirms the 50K for Oct. 3 and says registration remains open through Oct. 2. The course follows old-growth singletrack along Baker Lake with about 3,400 ft of climbing.
recommendations.why: A real spontaneous ultra option that fits your 50-mile build far better than a generic road race.

recommendations.title: Evergreen Fall Fest — Kettle Crest
recommendations.weather: Kettle Falls area: sunny, ~72–74°F days; much cooler at elevation
recommendations.description: Evergreen lists Fall Fest Oct. 1–4 at Kettle Crest: riding, trail work, camping and high-country fall scenery.
recommendations.why: A destination MTB weekend with a seasonal fall/larch hook instead of another generic trail-system visit.

recommendations.title: evo 25th Anniversary Raging River Bike Race
recommendations.weather: West-side forecast mostly sunny and mild
recommendations.description: evo is taking over Raging River for a three-hour lap-format race as part of its 25th-anniversary celebration, followed by the main Seattle party that night.
recommendations.why: Raging River is already worth the trip; the one-off race makes it substantially more compelling.

recommendations.title: John Summit — Experts Only at The Gorge
recommendations.cost: GA tickets still selectable; VIP sold out
recommendations.weather: Warm, dry afternoon; cooler after dark
recommendations.description: Experts Only runs Oct. 3–4 with John Summit plus Cassian, Daniel Allan, Devault, Hamdi, Jackie Hollander and Kettama. General admission remains on sale; VIP and hotel packages are sold out.
recommendations.why: Major Gorge weekend that is easy to stack after a local ride or race.

recommendations.title: Lastest Not Fastest Backyard Ultra
recommendations.weather: Columbia Gorge conditions should be dry/mild; verify morning wind
recommendations.description: A 4.13-mile last-person-standing loop every hour at Hamilton Island. Normal registration is closed, but the organizer explicitly says day-of-race signups are available.
recommendations.why: A genuinely unusual ultra format within your normal weekend radius and directly relevant to endurance training.

recommendations.title: Legends Never Die 55K / Half Marathon
recommendations.weather: High-elevation fall conditions; verify race-morning forecast
recommendations.description: The 55K climbs about 6,781 ft and reaches roughly 8,550 ft; the half marathon climbs about 2,450 ft. Race day is Oct. 3.
recommendations.why: Farther than normal, but a legitimate mountain-running destination if you want a hard training weekend.

recommendations.title: Willamette Superchamps CX
recommendations.description: OBRA's current cyclocross calendar lists Willamette Superchamps CX on Oct. 4 with registration available.
recommendations.why: The main sanctioned Oregon bike-racing option this weekend.

recommendations.title: Leavenworth Oktoberfest + Ride
recommendations.description: Use opening Oktoberfest weekend as the after-ride component to Ski Hill MTB, gravel, or a road ride rather than making the festival the entire trip.
recommendations.why: A strong seasonal reason to revisit a proven cycling destination.

recommendations.title: Nomad Birthday Run
recommendations.timing: Saturday, 7 AM to ~5 PM; join any segment
recommendations.description: Nomad Trail Runners' annual social run visits all four Tri-Cities and ends at Ice Harbor. Join for a few miles or a long block.
recommendations.why: Useful endurance mileage plus local community time without needing another race entry.

recommendations.title: Great Pumpkin Ride
recommendations.weather: Puget Sound forecast mostly sunny and mild
recommendations.description: Cascade Bicycle Club lists a roughly 65-mile vigorous ride with about 2,800 ft of climbing.
recommendations.why: A solid supported-road option if you want organized miles rather than racing.

recommendations.title: Bend Shoulder-Season MTB
recommendations.weather: NWS: sunny, ~80°F Sat / 85°F Sun in Bend; cooler in the forest/high country
recommendations.description: Phil's, Wanoga, Tiddlywinks or another Bend-area ride in dry early-October conditions.
recommendations.why: A proven destination with an unusually stable dry forecast.

recommendations.title: Joseph / Wallowas Fall Moto Weekend
recommendations.weather: Cool mornings; verify mountain forecast and forest access
recommendations.description: Use the early-October shoulder season for a scenic road/dual-sport loop with optional hiking or trail running.
recommendations.why: A familiar area with a strong seasonal reason to return.

recommendations.title: Gifford Pinchot Wishlist Day
recommendations.description: Advance an open Boundary Trail / Strawberry Ridge / Goat Mountain-area objective, with a same-day closure/fire check before departure.
recommendations.why: Moves a real wishlist objective forward rather than defaulting to an arbitrary forest-road loop.

recommendations.title: Oktober Feast 5K
recommendations.description: A simple local timed 5K that still leaves the rest of Saturday open.
recommendations.why: Low-friction speed work before TCKC or The Gorge.

recommendations.title: Snyder Dock Waterski
recommendations.timing: Best dawn window Sat or Sun
recommendations.weather: Sunny and warm; hourly wind determines quality
recommendations.description: One of the last comfortable local ski windows of the season if dawn winds stay light.
recommendations.why: Easy local activity that can be stacked with another event later in the day.
